description: Savor the authentic taste of the Middle East with this succulent Chicken Shawarma Spiced Rotisserie. Juicy chicken marinated in aromatic spices slowly roasts to perfection, creating a crispy skin and tender, flavorful meat. This show-stopping dish is perfect for a family meal or entertaining guests, bringing the vibrant flavors of shawarma right to your home.

instructions.title: Prepare the Shawarma Marinade
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, turmeric, cardamom, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, black pepper, and salt. Mix thoroughly until well combined. This is your aromatic shawarma marinade.

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
instructions.text: Pat the whole chicken dry with paper towels. Rub the shawarma marinade all over the chicken, making sure to get under the skin as much as possible for maximum flavor. Place the chicken in a large bag or covered dish and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, for best results.

instructions.title: Prepare for Rotisserie
instructions.text: Remove the chicken from the refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking to bring it closer to room temperature. Truss the chicken tightly with kitchen twine to ensure it cooks evenly and stays compact on the rotisserie spit. Securely mount the trussed chicken onto your rotisserie spit, ensuring it is balanced.

instructions.title: Preheat and Set Up Rotisserie
instructions.text: Preheat your oven or grill with a rotisserie attachment to a medium-high heat, around 375F (190C). Place a drip pan underneath the chicken to catch juices. Start the rotisserie, allowing the chicken to rotate slowly.

instructions.title: Rotisserie Cook the Chicken
instructions.text: Cook the chicken on the rotisserie for approximately 1 hour 45 minutes to 2 hours, or until the internal temperature reaches 165F (74C) in the thickest part of the thigh without touching the bone. The skin should be deeply golden brown and crispy.

instructions.title: Rest and Carve
instructions.text: Once cooked, carefully remove the chicken from the rotisserie spit. Transfer it to a cutting board and tent loosely with foil. Let the chicken rest for 10-15 minutes before carving. This allows the juices to redistribute, resulting in a more tender and flavorful chicken.

instructions.title: Serve Your Shawarma
instructions.text: Carve the chicken into thin slices, just like traditional shawarma. Serve hot with warm pita bread, fresh vegetables, pickles, and a drizzle of tahini sauce or garlic sauce. It's also excellent in wraps or over rice.

tips: For an extra crispy skin, pat the chicken very dry before applying the marinade and consider adding a pinch of baking powder to the spice mix.
Allowing the chicken to marinate overnight truly deepens the flavors. If you're short on time, a minimum of 2 hours will still yield delicious results.
Leftover shawarma chicken is fantastic in salads, sandwiches, or even scrambled eggs. Store it in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3-4 days.
